segments.title: A giant bird named from ONE bone
segments.sub: Found in the **Hobbit cave** on Flores
segments.say: Scientists named a brand new giant bird from just one bone.

segments.title: Meet Megapodius rokusi
segments.say: Meet Megapodius rokusi, an extinct cousin of the chicken.

segments.title: Several times HEAVIER
segments.sub: vs the megapode living on **Flores today**
segments.say: The megapode living on Flores today weighs up to about one kilo. This one was about three point nine kilos.

segments.title: Half of one LEG bone
segments.say: All from half of one leg bone, bigger than in any other known species of its kind.

segments.title: Up to 190,000 years old
segments.say: The cave layers are about one hundred twenty to one hundred ninety thousand years old.
Follow for Weird Animal number 20 tomorrow.
